note: Synthetic commission plan. Clause ids are cited by evidence bundles.
name: Account Executive Commission Plan 2026

clauses.P-2.1: Commission credit follows the CRM split assignments on the closed-won opportunity. Splits on an opportunity must total exactly 100%.
clauses.P-3.1: Eligible value is the signed contract value, adjusted by amendments signed on or before the measurement cutoff. The amendment with the latest effective date governs.
clauses.P-3.2: The commissionable base is net cash collected (payments with a value date on or before the cutoff, less refunds and less credit notes issued on or before the cutoff), capped at the eligible value and floored at zero.
clauses.P-4.1: The commission rate is the rate of the plan version in effect on the opportunity close date.
clauses.P-4.2: Timing is determined by the value date or issue date of a financial event, not by the date it was recorded in a system.
clauses.P-5.1: A rate exception applies only when it has status APPROVED and carries an approval reference.
clauses.P-6.1: Commission due = commissionable base x split percentage x rate, rounded half-up to the cent once, at the end.
clauses.P-7.1: Only opportunities in stage closed_won are commissionable.
